options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an accounts-payable extraction system. Read the vendor email and attachment text and return the purchase order response as JSON matching the schema. Numbers are plain numbers (9648.00, not "9,648.00"). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Copy part numbers exactly as printed. If a field is genuinely absent use an empty string, 0, or an empty array; never invent values. Set extraction_confidence low when the text is ambiguous, truncated, or the totals do not add up. Today is {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-LL-dd') }}.

nodes.name: LmStudioExtractorModel
nodes.notes: Lab model. Customer instance: swap for their approved provider (Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, or OpenRouter) by replacing this sub-node.

parameters.query:
select p.po_number, p.vendor_id, v.name as vendor_name, v.email_domain, p.currency, p.order_date, p.status, p.total_amount,
  coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('line_no', l.line_no, 'sku', l.sku, 'description', l.description,
    'quantity', l.quantity, 'unit_price', l.unit_price, 'line_total', l.line_total, 'promised_date', l.promised_date)
    order by l.line_no) filter (where l.line_no is not null), '[]'::jsonb) as lines
from om_poc.purchase_orders p
join om_poc.vendors v on v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id
left join om_poc.po_lines l on l.po_number = p.po_number
where upper(p.po_number) = upper($1)
group by p.po_number, p.vendor_id, v.name, v.email_domain, p.currency, p.order_date, p.status, p.total_amount;

insert into om_poc.reconciled_po_responses (reconciliation_id, po_number, vendor_name, document_type, currency,

parameters.content:
## 1. Intake

Vendor replies arrive in the AP mailbox (Outlook trigger, disabled on the lab). The fixture webhook plays the same role for testing. NormalizeEmail turns either shape into one envelope with any PDF in $binary.attachment.

## 2. Decipher

PDF text is pulled with Extract from File and joined with the email body. The Information Extractor reads that text against a fixed JSON schema (PO, vendor, lines, totals, self-reported confidence). No tools, no agent loop.

## 3. Validate against the PO

The PO on record is fetched (SAP stand-in). Nine weighted business rules run over the extraction: PO exists, vendor, currency, lines map, quantities, prices within 2%, totals within 1%. Score = 70% rules + 30% model confidence; hard rules always force review. Every attempt is logged and the caller gets the decision back.

## 4. HITL gate

Score >= 0.90 with no hard failure posts automatically. Anything else emails the AP reviewer a side-by-side with Approve / Reject links and the execution waits on that click.

## 5. Convert and post

Validated data becomes an ORDERS05 IDoc (ORDRSP / INVOIC / DESADV by document type), is queued for SAP, written to the Snowflake landing table, and the reconciliation is marked posted or rejected. AP gets one outcome email either way.

## 6. Failures

Every fallible node routes its error output here. Ops gets the error, the email subject and the execution id. Nothing is posted on a failure.

## O&M PoC: Purchase Order Reconciliation

Decipher non-EDI vendor email responses (PDF or text), validate with business rules plus AI, gate on a HITL threshold, and post validated data as XML/IDoc to SAP and Snowflake.

Lab stand-ins and what the customer swaps:
1. WatchOutlookInbox: Outlook OAuth2 credential on the AP mailbox, plus a Get Attachment step.
2. LmStudioExtractorModel: the approved LLM provider (Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, OpenRouter).
3. LookupPurchaseOrder: SAP OData/RFC read of EKKO/EKPO, same output shape.
4. QueueIdocForSap: HTTP Request to the SAP PI/PO or CPI IDoc endpoint.
5. WriteSnowflakeLandingRow: the Snowflake node, same column list.

Tuning lives at the top of ApplyValidationRules: AUTO_THRESHOLD 0.90, PRICE_TOLERANCE_PCT 2, TOTAL_TOLERANCE_PCT 1, AI_WEIGHT 0.30.

Test: POST a fixture to /webhook/om-po-response (see data/fixtures). Mail lands in Mailpit at localhost:8025.
